deploy-bot: Starting PROD rollout: tag=v2.3.1 commit=abc1234 release-window=02:00-04:00 UTC env=prod regions=[us,europe,apac]. Planned staggers -> us: now, eu: +5m, apac: +10m. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/2.3.1 :rocket:
elaine: on it, watching logs and latencies.
sam: can we pin the legacy-session migration flag in eu? QA says not ready there.
priyanka: seeing spike in eu 503s ~30s after start. short error dump below:
```
2026-01-12T02:05:14Z error inference pipeline: http 503 x 27 auth-ok, queue-depth=12
stack: kv-cache miss -> timeout
```
priyanka: recommending pause for eu until we triage.
deploy-bot: APAC deploy failed preflight -> initiating rollback for apac to v2.3.0 commit=9f8e7d. Reason: tokenization OOM on some batches. Status: rollback-in-progress.
matt: ack rollback. Also pin AcmeCorp (dedicated) to v2.3.0 until we validate.
jordan: switching canary to us-only, pausing eu/apac. @ops-rotations please throttle and monitor request queues.
ops-rotations: :white_check_mark: throttling applied, preserving 10% capacity for fallback routes. watching errors and retransmit rates.
deploy-bot: Progress update: us=success(v2.3.1) health=pass, eu=paused(held at v2.3.0) health=degraded, apac=rolled-back(v2.3.0) post-rollback health=pass. Next: open INC and plan hotfix for tokenization path (~60m ETA).
priyanka: opened incident INC-2026-042 on PagerDuty, paging infra + runtime. Notifying product about possible change-window extension.
elaine: posting short update to #product and will add quick blurb to release notes link about partial rollout.
deploy-bot: Finalizing: rollout finished (partial). Region tags: us=v2.3.1, eu=v2.3.0 (paused), apac=v2.3.0 (rollback). Notes: pin applied for AcmeCorp, migration-flag revert for eu. Closing thread unless new regressions reported. :lock:
